subject: Seapoint pilot: deposit sweep, staged invoices, and VAT certification
messages:
From: Aaron Michaels <aaron@seapointhealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: finance@seapointhealth.com
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Payment terms for Q2 pilot (Net60 request)

Hi Olga / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team excited to start the Q2 pilot. Our finance team has a standard Net60 cadence for new vendors. For the SOW attached, can you confirm Redwood can accept Net60 for the initial three invoices? If not, what guardrails would you propose to keep our pilot moving while addressing Redwood's billing concerns?

Also attaching our VAT certificate for reference (EU operations). Happy to set a quick call if needed.

Thanks,
Aaron Michaels
Sr. Procurement Manager
Seapoint Health

Attachment: Seapoint_VAT_certificate.pdf (pdf, 124KB)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Aaron Michaels <aaron@seapointhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment terms for Q2 pilot (Net60 request)

Aaron —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the VAT certificate. We can support a pilot with a Net60 cadence, but we need a combination of mitigations given usage and capacity commitments:

- 30% upfront deposit on contract signature (applied to first invoice).
- Staged invoice sweep: monthly invoices with an automated sweep on day 15 after invoice issuance for any balance above $25k.
- VAT evidence: for EU-chargeable items we will require the VAT certificate to be uploaded to our portal and validated prior to the first invoice being finalized.
- Credit guardrail: initial credit cap at $150k exposure; Redwood to review after 45 days and scale to $300k on satisfactory payment behavior.

I've attached an updated SOW (v3) with the deposit and sweep clauses marked. If that structure works, we can provide a conditional DocuSign package for signature.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW_Seapoint_Q2_v3.pdf (pdf, 210KB); DocuSign_StatementOfWork_4721.pdf (link)

Thanks Olga — that sounds reasonable. A couple quick clarifications from our side before routing to sign-off:

1) Will the 30% deposit be refundable if the pilot is terminated early by either party?
2) On the sweep: can you confirm which bank reference we should include and whether the sweep is ACH-only or supports wire transfers?
3) For the VAT validation, is a scanned certificate sufficient or do you need a portal-verified tax ID?

If you can respond to these three points I can escalate to CFO for conditional approval.

—Sophie
Finance Business Partner, Seapoint Health

Hi Sophie / Aaron —

Quick answers inline: 

1) Refundability: The deposit is refundable only against agreed termination for cause or full completion of pilot milestones; otherwise it offsets final invoice. We can add a 30-day notice clause for early termination to protect both sides.

2) Sweep mechanics: We support ACH (preferred) and wire. Sweep executes against the payment method on file. Bank reference: Redwood Inc. / ABA 122000247 / Acct xxxxxx1234 (will provide secure banking details in the DocuSign payment schedule).

3) VAT evidence: A scanned VAT certificate is acceptable for initial validation, but for full VAT pass-through we require portal verification of tax ID within 10 business days of signature. Until verification completes Redwood will hold a 5% VAT reserve on invoice totals for EU billables.

If those are acceptable we can mark up the SOW and send the DocuSign envelope today.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
